rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for a court finding A guilty.

example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 zo2 keoi5 jau5 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal legal contexts or when condemning someone as morally guilty.

example.english: With conclusive evidence, the court will convict the defendant.
example.traditional: 證據確鑿，法庭將定罪被告。
example.jyutping: zing3 geoi3 kok3 zok6 faat3 ting4 zoeng1 ding6 zeoi6 bei6 gou3

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose term for a person convicted of a crime, especially one in custody.

example.english: The police escorted the convict back to prison.
example.traditional: 警方將個犯人押返監獄。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zoeng1 go3 faan6 jan4 aat3 faan2 gaam1 juk6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the person is a criminal convicted of an offence rather than simply someone in custody.

example.english: The judge sentenced that convict to five years in prison.
example.traditional: 法官判嗰個罪犯入獄五年。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 pun3 go2 go3 zeoi6 faan2 jap6 juk6 ng5 nin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a convicted person serving a prison sentence.

example.english: Each convict in the prison has to exercise every day.
example.traditional: 監獄入面嘅囚犯每日都要做運動。
example.jyutping: gaam1 juk6 jap6 min6 ge3 cau4 faan2 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 wan6 dung6
